description: This Java class 'SSLUtil' provides utility methods for setting up SSL/TLS connections, managing trust and key managers, SSL contexts, socket factories, and hostname verification, specifically for configuring SSL connections with client certificates within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SSLUtil
classes.description: Final utility class for SSL configuration and management within OFBiz, including trust managers, key managers, SSL contexts, socket factories, and hostname verification.

classes.name: TrustAnyManager
classes.description: Inner class implementing X509TrustManager that trusts all certificates without validation, used for bypassing SSL certificate checks.

methods.name: getHostCertNoCheck
methods.description: Returns constant indicating no certificate check for hostname verification.

methods.name: getHostCertMinCheck
methods.description: Returns constant indicating minimum certificate check level for hostname verification.

methods.name: getHostCertNormalCheck
methods.description: Returns constant indicating normal certificate check level for hostname verification.

methods.name: isClientTrusted
methods.description: Checks if a given certificate chain is trusted based on current trust managers.

methods.name: getKeyManagers
methods.description: Retrieves key managers from keystores, optionally for a specific alias.

methods.name: getTrustManagers
methods.description: Retrieves trust managers including system trust store and additional keystores.

methods.name: getTrustAnyManagers
methods.description: Provides trust managers that trust all certificates.

methods.name: getSSLSocketFactory
methods.description: Creates an SSLSocketFactory from keystore, password, and alias.

methods.name: getSSLContext
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext with specified keystore, trust settings, and optional trust-all behavior.

methods.name: getSSLServerSocketFactory
methods.description: Creates an SSLServerSocketFactory from keystore, password, and alias.

methods.name: getHostnameVerifier
methods.description: Returns a HostnameVerifier based on specified verification level.

methods.name: loadJsseProperties
methods.description: Loads JSSE properties from configuration for SSL setup.
